newsitem.title: BULGARIA: No bids received at Bulgaria 4-wk T-bill auction.
newsitem.headline: No bids received at Bulgaria 4-wk T-bill auction.

text.p: A four-week discount T-bill issue offered by Bulgaria's Finance Ministry at an auction on Friday with no par value set in advance was unsold due to a lack of bids, the central bank said.
"Four weeks are not an attractive maturity at the moment because the rapid dollar rise provides bigger profits," said a dealer.

The lev slumped to 1,930-2,000 per dollar at Friday's close from 1,530-1,590 on Thursday and 935-950 on Monday. It was expected to fall further amid the ongoing political deadlock and deepening economic crisis, dealers said.
The Finance Ministry has issued one-week and four-week discount T-bills with no par value set in advance daily since January 20.
